title: Sheltered lace
question: Does a shade roof change how Sporeveils fare on drying gel?
intervention: Run the dish for 10 minutes. Tap a gel cell under the roof and one on the open gel to compare their moisture, and compare the Sporeveils’ life states in each place.
predictedTradeoff: Under the roof the gel dries more slowly, so Sporeveils there should keep their suitability longer; the roof also shades, which a Sporeveil does not need. Neither patch is promised to survive.
confounds: The two patches also differ in where their spores land and how much debris each group finds. Moisture is read as the mean over each region, so a region’s edge cells count as much as its centre. This is one run.

completion.journalStamp: Compared Sporeveils under a roof and on open gel
